styleLaneCards.cliffs: seasonal structural cliff sheets; recipes pending
surface highlands only; no vertical faces

runtimeMigration.legacyFlatCliffTiles: normalize exterior cells to grass near coasts or rock ground elsewhere
runtimeMigration.legacyNaturalObjectFootprints: normalize built-in natural objects from the generated authored-object atlas manifest; preserve pack-defined custom objects
runtimeMigration.legacyWetSand: normalize to V7 Sand; no wet-sand band remains

authoredContactPolicy.shoreMaterial: V7 Sand for marine coasts and V7 Mud/Dirt for inland banks; Gravel is general ground and is used as shore only by an explicit highland generation rule
authoredContactPolicy.repair: Exact mode preserves unsupported MountainPath/Sand contacts for diagnostics. Coast and Hydrology modes may replace touching MountainPath cells with the authored V7 Dirt_Tan road shoulder.
authoredContactPolicy.detailVariantPolicy: quiet V7 owner fills for Sand, Gravel, MountainPath, Rock Ground, CaveFloor, Mud, and all non-grass surface materials; audited single-cell grass accents only in homogeneous interiors
authoredContactPolicy.multiCellDetailPolicy: promote complete authored detail assemblies into explicit object/stamp metadata and place atomically or skip; never crop, scatter, or partially place

waterDepthPolicy.source: exact source-pure terrain-map-v7 corner tuples repacked into the normalized V7 runtime atlas
waterDepthPolicy.renderOrigin: corner tuples render at the four-cell intersection using the shared half-tile down/right origin
waterDepthPolicy.unsupportedTuples: keep quiet V7 owner fills, flag the tuple in F3 diagnostics, and normalize topology before save/worldgen certification; never borrow another style or synthesize pixels
waterDepthPolicy.editorMutationPolicy: Exact mode never creates a shallow-water band around a painted land tile. Coast and Hydrology modes are the only editor paths allowed to alter neighboring water depth.

propFootprintPolicy.preview: blue visual bounds use the exact deterministic authored atlas variant manifest
propFootprintPolicy.collision: collision bounds use the same variant manifest and may be smaller than visual bounds
propFootprintPolicy.interaction: yellow interaction bounds remain independent from visual bounds

runtimePolicy: One contiguous landmass uses one style lane. The current test world is V7-only until the ElizaWy mainland mapping is independently certified.

normalizedAtlasPolicy.pixelPolicy: exact source cells may be repacked with padding; recoloring, pixel synthesis, and cross-style blending are forbidden

modes.label: Exact
modes.behavior: paint only selected semantic cells; do not mutate neighboring water or terrain
modes.unsupportedContacts: leave unchanged and report in F3/native-editor status

modes.label: Coast
modes.behavior: explicitly rebuild the local authored shoreline and compatible V7 material contacts around the edited region

modes.label: Hydrology
modes.behavior: explicitly resolve canonical shallow/deep water inside the edited neighborhood using Hydrology V2

terrainPaintModes.previewPolicy: selected mode is visible in both F3 and native Scene Editor before commit
